Name: Fading Torches - Immersive Torch Lighting and Light Radius
Author: AnnaCharles
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Fading Torches[/size][/b][/center]
[center][i]Immersive Torch Lighting and Light Radius[/i][/center]
[center][i]Torches are no longer permanent lights.[/i][/center]

[center]Fading Torches gives Stardew Valley’s Torches a real lifecycle. They slowly burn down, lose brightness and light reach, struggle through bad weather, and eventually go out.[/center]

[center]Refuel them with Coal, leave an Empty Torch in place for later, or light a Torch to carry with you through the night.[/center]
[center]No complicated survival systems. No permanent fuel bars. Just more atmosphere, usefulness, and life in the dark.[/center]

[center][youtube]hGaBDwUCFWk[/youtube][/center]
[center]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b]A little support goes a long way.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Endorsements, comments, and feedback help these mods grow and inspire what comes next.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Thanks for being part of it.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[/center]



[b]🔥TORCHES NOW BURN OUT[/b]
[list]
[*]Placed Torches progress through:[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Full → Faded → Weak → Low → Ember → Empty[/b]
As fuel runs down, the flame becomes weaker and the surrounding light gradually shrinks.[/*]
[*][b]Placed Torch Life Cycle[/b]
5–14 in-game ageing days
Default: 7 days
The same fade cycle stretches across your chosen lifespan, so you can make Torch maintenance frequent or very relaxed.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Empty Torches stay where you placed them until you refuel or remove them.[/*]
[*]Use [b]1 Coal[/b] on a fading or Empty Torch to restore it immediately to Full. [/*]
[*]Removing a used, refuelled, or Empty Torch gives: [b]2 Sap[/b][/*]
[*][b]🌧 Weather Matters - Outdoor Torches age 2× faster during: [/b]
Rain.Storms.Snow
Indoor Torches age normally.[/*]
[/list]

[b]🌑PERFECT WITH DARK DESCENT
[/b]Fading Torches is an especially good match for our other mod:
Dark Descent
Dark Descent makes supported dungeon floors dynamically darker while still allowing real light sources to shine through.
Together:
[list]
[*]darker caves make Torches genuinely useful.[/*]
[*]portable Torchlight becomes much more valuable underground.[/*]
[*]fading light makes deeper exploration feel more atmospheric.[/*]
[*]lighting a fresh Torch before pushing onward actually matters.[/*]
[/list]Dark Descent handles the darkness.
Fading Torches gives you the light.
Neither mod requires the other.


[b]🕯️PORTABLE TORCHLIGHT[/b]
Torches can also become temporary portable lights.
Simply holding a Torch does [b]not[/b] give free light.
Select one and use [b]right-click / alternate use[/b].
You’ll be asked:
[b]Light Torch?[/b]
Confirming consumes [b]1 Torch[/b] and creates a warm light that follows your farmer, sits slightly ahead of the direction you’re facing, and stays active even when you switch tools or items.

[b]⏳ PORTABLE BURN TIME[/b]
Portable Torches burn using Stardew’s [b]in-game clock.[/b]
Paused time does not consume fuel.
[b]Portable Torch Burn Time[/b]
[b]60–1200 in-game minutes[/b]
Default: [b]360 minutes / about 6 in-game hours[/b]
Changing the setting does not alter a Torch already burning. The new duration applies the next time you light a fresh one.
Portable Torches also burn at [b]2× speed outdoors in Rain, Storm, or Snow[/b].


[b]💡 ADJUSTABLE LIGHT REACH[/b]
Fading Torches also includes built-in light-reach controls.
[b]Object Light Reach[/b]
Default: [b]2.5[/b]
[b]Furniture Light Reach[/b]
Default: [b]3.0[/b]
[b]Portable Torch Reach[/b]
Default: [b]2.5[/b]


[b]❤️ THE BRIGHT IDEA[/b]
Fading Torches is designed to make light feel a little more alive.
A Torch slowly reaching Ember beside an old farm path.
A storm wearing down your outdoor lights.
Throwing Coal into a fading Torch before heading home.
Lighting one last Torch before descending deeper underground.
Small mechanics - but enough to make the darkness matter again.



[b]⚙️ REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[b]Required[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[/list][b]Recommended[/b]
[list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list]No other mods are required.


💡 COMPATIBILITY / GAMEPLAY CLARIFICATION
Fading Torches is built around Stardew Valley and SMAPI’s normal runtime systems and does not depend on another mod’s content for its core features.
Torch ageing, weather effects, Coal refuelling, portable Torchlight, burn duration, replacement prompts, multiplayer handling, and light reach are controlled by Fading Torches’ own programmed rules and configuration.
The mod does not copy or redistribute another mod’s source code, assets, lighting systems, dialogue, sprites, maps, or other authored content.
Vanilla Torch is the officially supported Torch type for V1. Generic Mod Config Menu is supported, and Fading Torches is designed to work especially well alongside Dark Descent without requiring it.

🤖 AI DISCLOSURE
AI assistance was used during development of Fading Torches for planning, coding, debugging, automated testing, and documentation.
The mod’s concept, design decisions, balance, hands-on gameplay testing, and final approval were done by ACharles.
Fading Torches does not use AI, an LLM, or any generative system while Stardew Valley is running. All gameplay and lighting behaviour is controlled through predefined rules and programmed game logic.
